title: Forms Blueprint Try Module Preview
description: Consolidate forms to Blueprint+Try windows, runtime Contribution/ExternalSlot mechanism, forms-module-procedural plugin for buildingComponent preview.
summary:
Fixed two regressions blocking forms premigration parity:

1. **forms-module-procedural crash** — `create_module_app()` now declares Params + Preview window kinds with a default row layout, satisfying the framework `window_kinds.is_empty()` invariant. Regression test `module_app_declares_window_kinds` added.

2. **Empty fresh Forms document** — `FormsPlayApp::initial_document_json()` now seeds from `building_component_envelope()` (Building Component fixture) instead of `empty_forms_projection()`. Regression test `initial_document_seeds_building_component_fixture` added.

**Verification:** Rebuilt wasm plugins (forms, forms-module-procedural, flow, procedural). `plugin-runtime-check.mjs` passes: procedural module manifest + params/preview render; fresh forms-play shows Building Component questions; step 2 emits `forms-module-procedural` external slots; generate mode works in flow/procedural2d/procedural3d (add/rename/remove + preview). React dev host blocked on native macOS by pre-existing Vite/`bun:` scheme issue; wgpu trunk serves but UI did not paint in automation — wasm path verified via Node instead. Details in verify-log.md.
